description: A young man in a backwards red cap and a white tank top stands at a long table at a hot dog eating contest on a sunny seaside boardwalk under strings of colourful flags. He throws his head back and pumps his fist in the air as he swallows a hot dog. A young woman beside him holds a cup and a jug of water, a referee in a striped shirt stands nearby, and another contestant in a blue tank top sits at the table. Trays of hot dogs, bowls of water and sauce bottles cover the table, and a big crowd cheers with raised arms behind.

taps.target: the man in the red cap

taps.phrase: to pour water from a jug

taps.target: the man in the blue top
